objectives: 本課程提供工程數學所需要的預備知識，第一學期包含解常微分方程以及特殊函數介紹，第二學期包含Laplace transform＆傅立葉轉換以及解析偏微分方程，需要預備基本函數微分與積分的技巧以及線性代數，相關的基礎數學知識應用於工程以及科學相關領域。
content:
First semester includes:

P A R T A Ordinary Differential Equations (ODEs)

CHAPTER 1 First-Order ODEs

CHAPTER 2 Second-Order Linear ODEs

CHAPTER 3 Higher Order Linear ODEs

CHAPTER 4 Systems of ODEs. Phase Plane. Qualitative Methods

(First semester: Exam1: Chap1-2, Exam2: Chap3-4)

Second semester includes:
CHAPTER 5 Series Solutions of ODEs. Special Functions

CHAPTER 6 Laplace Transforms

CHAPTER 11 Fourier Analysis.
CHAPTER 12 Partial Differential Equations (PDEs)

(Second semester: Exam1: Chap5/6, Exam2: Chap11-12)
